title: IBM TRIRIGA Application Platform 5.0.0 through 5.0.9 IBM TRIRIGA could allow a remote authenticated attacker to…
description: IBM TRIRIGA Application Platform versions 5.0.0 through 5.0.9 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. This occurs due to improper neutralization of special elements in operating system commands, leading to command injection. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.8, indicating significant impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
